<thought>I will search the template catalog for a forward reaction that forms a C‑C double bond while breaking a trimethylsilyl group and an aliphatic hydroxyl group, which corresponds to the Peterson elimination.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",

  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
